packages.name: se_log_analyser
packages.supplier: Organization: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.comment: Analyzes SELinux audit logs and generates policy recommendations enriched with process context, command information, and hierarchical relationships. Supports incremental analysis, file merging, and JSON output. SHA256 checksumValue MUST be replaced with actual hash of release artifact.

packages.name: se_policy_merger
packages.supplier: Organization: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.comment: Consolidates multiple SELinux policy .te files into a unified policy, deduplicating rules and generating proper require blocks. Supports allow, role, type_transition, role_transition, typeattribute, and type rules. SHA256 checksumValue MUST be replaced with actual hash of release artifact.

packages.name: se_check_type
packages.supplier: Organization: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.copyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP
packages.comment: Validates that all types referenced in a SELinux policy file exist on the target host. Can automatically create missing types or remove invalid references. SHA256 checksumValue MUST be replaced with actual hash of release artifact.

packages.name: psutil
packages.comment: Cross-platform library for retrieving information on running processes and system utilization. Required by se_log_analyser for process tree inspection. Minimum tested version: 5.9.8 (Rocky Linux 10.1, Ubuntu 24.04.3). Also tested with 7.0.0 (SLES 16.0, Debian 13).

packages.name: Python
packages.comment: Python interpreter runtime required by all three tools. Minimum Python version required: 3.9 (uses dataclasses, typing). Tested versions: 3.12.3 (Ubuntu 24.04.3), 3.12.12 (Rocky Linux 10.1), 3.13.5 (SLES 16.0, Debian 13).

packages.name: audit2allow
packages.comment: SELinux policy rule generator from audit denial messages. Part of the policycoreutils package. Version .1 observed consistently across all tested platforms. Required by se_log_analyser. System package: policycoreutils (RHEL/Fedora/Rocky), policycoreutils (Debian/Ubuntu/SLES). Tested on: Rocky Linux 10.1 (v.1), SLES 16.0 (v.1), Debian 13 (v.1), Ubuntu 24.04.3 (v.1).

packages.name: ausearch
packages.comment: Queries the Linux audit subsystem logs for specific events. Part of the audit package. Required by se_log_analyser. Minimum tested version: 3.1.2. Tested versions: 3.1.2 (Ubuntu 24.04.3), 4.0 (SLES 16.0), 4.0.2 (Debian 13), 4.0.3 (Rocky Linux 10.1).

packages.name: aureport
packages.comment: Produces summary reports from the Linux audit logs. Part of the audit package (co-versioned with ausearch). Required by se_log_analyser. Minimum tested version: 3.1.2. Tested versions: 3.1.2 (Ubuntu 24.04.3), 4.0 (SLES 16.0), 4.0.2 (Debian 13), 4.0.3 (Rocky Linux 10.1).
